taskPacket.objective: Worker providers never receive the controller-only notification transport PLAN_RUNNER_NOTIFY_BIN, and Job.budgetStop's type admits the wallclock outcome the live loop already produces.
instructions: childEnv (scripts/supervisor.mjs) deletes PLAN_RUNNER_NOTIFY_BIN after the driver overlay, so no driver can reintroduce it.
The Job typedef's budgetStop widens to "node"|"campaign"|"wallclock".
A supervisor test starts a glm provider and asserts the transport is absent while ambient variables and the driver overlay still arrive.
nonGoals: Removing any other variable from the provider environment: the driver overlay and every other ambient variable reach the provider unchanged.
